lines.en: Nobody would be charged for this homicide though as Haruka Hamasaki had already proclaimed earlier that she was currently seeking death and it’s not like she has anyone to press charges on her behalf anyway.
lines.zh: 不过，这桩凶杀案不会有人被起诉，因为 Haruka Hamasaki 早先已经宣告过她正在寻死，而且反正也没有人会替她提起诉讼。

lines.en: Perhaps this is just one of those “what goes around comes around” type things and this night is just her penance for all of her sins.
lines.zh: 也许这只是那种「善恶到头终有报」的事，这一夜不过是她为所有罪孽做的苦行。

lines.en: If only she’d been better, she’d have someone to hear her out while she’s at her lowest. If only that thing about beauty being in the eyes of the beholder didn’t mean you need to take someone’s eyes out to see stuff.
lines.zh: 要是她曾经做得更好一些，在她最低谷的时候就会有人愿意听她倾诉。要是「情人眼里出西施」这句话，不需要你把别人的眼珠子挖出来才能看见东西就好了。

lines.en: And if only you could see Akira’s at all so you could theorize just what level of consciousness he possesses for this event and whether or not it’s actually even happening when I’ve already told you it is.
lines.zh: 要是你真能看见 Akira 的眼睛，你就能推断出他在这场戏里到底拥有什么程度的意识，以及这一幕到底是不是真的在发生——尽管我已经告诉过你它正在发生。

lines.en: It’s never been the specifics that matter, though. That’s just the thing. Because you’ve caught the gist already and the dialogue is just supplementary padding that isn’t going to make this {i}sadder{/i} or {i}happier.{/i}
lines.zh: 不过，重要的从来不是那些细节。问题就在这儿。因为你已经抓住要领了，那些对话不过是补充的填充物，不会让这一段{i}更悲伤{/i}，也不会让它{i}更快乐{/i}。

lines.en: Trashed and discarded, invisible worm — you fly through the night to a brokerage firm.
lines.zh: 被丢弃、被抛弃的无形蠕虫——你飞过黑夜，去往一家证券公司。

lines.en: Trade your selfies for cell-shaded colorful burns that will make you look pretty when, to home, you return.
lines.zh: 用你的自拍换些赛璐璐上色的斑斓灼痕，好让你回家的时候看起来漂亮些。

lines.en: I have wandered this planet, sometimes whole, sometimes half. Through these journeys I’ve learned that attorneys don’t laugh.
lines.zh: 我在这颗星球上游荡过，有时完整，有时残缺。在这些旅程中我学到了，律师是不会笑的。

lines.en: And for what I’d like to say is the first time but is realistically the millionth, the part of her that’s still present is currently regretting ever meeting the man who did this to her in the first place.
lines.zh: 而我想说这是第一次、但实际上大概已是第一百万次——她尚还清醒的那部分，正在后悔当初认识了那个把她弄成这样的男人。

lines.en: Those thoughts will fade, though. And not just because the dark is slowly setting in, but because they {i}always{/i} fade even when it’s not.
lines.zh: 不过这些念头会淡去。不只是因为夜色正在慢慢降临，而是因为就算夜色不来，它们也{i}总会{/i}淡去。

lines.en: This felt nothing like love. And some days, that is what she wanted — somehow not realizing it’s something she already has.
lines.zh: 这一点也不像爱。而有些日子，她想要的就是这个——却浑然不觉这东西她其实已经拥有了。

lines.en: It’s just up on a shelf she can’t reach because she spends so much of her time on her knees.
lines.zh: 它只是搁在她够不着的架子上，因为她太多时间都跪在地上。

lines.en: Was there anyone out there willing to save her, though?
lines.zh: 可是，外面有任何人愿意救她吗？

lines.en: Someone unlike Akira. Someone caring and kind and not prone to lengthy lapses of self that may or may not result in what may or may not have happened here tonight.
